annotations.text:
CANONICAL — the decided CoGra app. Each row is a section; this canvas grows as sections are decided. Options and ideation live on standalone canvases ('CoGra entry' holds the entry section's three directions; 'CoGra compose' holds the compose rounds).

Section ENTRY, decided 2026-08-27: the landing is the live public feed (Open door) with a borrowed-view band; every ceremonial step is a full-focus screen. People and photos are mock; @mira is the inviter, @noa stands in for the genesis moderator.

Section COMPOSE, decided 2026-08-27 (rows below Entry): the body-first wizard — pick the body, cover for video, one details screen, then the seal. @sol is the member writing.

Theme: use the 'Canvas theme' board to the right — one tap themes every screen. A screen's own chip can pin light or dark; 'auto' follows your system.

ENTRY · Arrive & browse

A guest feed is ranked from a borrowed vantage point: an invite link carries its inviter's view, a bare arrival borrows the genesis moderator's. The band names the borrowed view and carries the one join entry. The APK line rides the collapsing top (dev phase; a store link later).

ENTRY · Join

Invite entry, the vouch screen (the inviter's face leads), the unusable-link state, and the landing page of the verification mail. Handle 3–30 chars a–z 0–9 _, password 12+, both checked at the form.

ENTRY · Your key

Created on this device, never held by CoGra. 'Create my recovery code' first opens the think-twice dialog — Cancel falls back to Your key, 'Show my code' commits. The code screen is a TRAP: no back arrow, the only way out is the code typed or pasted back ('I've written it down'). Copy stays — pasting into a password manager is a legitimate keeping. Declining backup is a destructive dialog whose SAFE action is filled.

ENTRY · Applicant days

Same shell as a member, application riding as cards: verify + key first, then waiting on the inviter, then the landing moment. The first vouch opens the STANCE PAD (not sliders), preloaded at +0.10 / +0.10, resting 16px above the bottom bar. Onboarding is per-control and the pad is the ONLY control on these screens that gets first-time explainers: what it is for, how it opens (hold a face; a plain tap signs +0.10 / +0.10), that nothing signs until Set, and that the input can be swapped in settings. Acting is gated but visible (compose at 38%). The borrowed view persists until this first stance.

ENTRY · Sign in & restore

Sign in (with the APK line), password reset (no account enumeration; reset revokes every session), restoring the key, and the key-elsewhere banner. 'Restore your key' and 'Key elsewhere' carry a wording tweak: browser ('on this browser') vs app ('in this app') — the Android app says app, the web says browser. Login restores the service session; only the recovery code restores the key.

COMPOSE · The wizard

Body first (the Instagram/YouTube spine): pick the body → crop → (cover, video only) → details → the seal; 'Write words instead' is the text path and skips crop and cover. The body is words OR what you show, never both. The pick screen: a PICKED TRAY on top (one line, 'Show all' on overflow) over the newest-first grid; the grid's first tile opens the device's own photos app, and picks made there land in the tray. THE CROP (Instagram's model): one shape for the whole post — Tall 4:5, Square 1:1, or Wide 1.91:1 — with drag-to-move and pinch-to-zoom per picture; 4:5 as the tallest shape is what guarantees the post ladder's height cap. Screens carry no step numbers (paths differ in length; the title names the stage, only the seal says 'Last step'). COPY RULE (2026-08-27): captions are one short line; the full explanation lives behind a small ? that opens a plain dialog — AT MOST ONE ? PER SCREEN, top-right of the header (or of the sheet/card it explains: the pads carry their own). It covers every compose explainer: cost and the community pool, the all-or-nothing batch, license terms and immutability, the stance side effects, the pending lifecycle, edit history. BUTTONS: filled and outlined pills carry 24px side padding and a 64px minimum width, so short labels (Next, Set, Done) keep their weight. The example everywhere: 1 post + 2 topics + 1 reference = 4 signed actions.

COMPOSE · The seal

'What you sign' is a place, not a popup — no 'don't ask again'. The manifest lists every act with its cost; the batch lands whole or not at all (resolves Q43). The three row-openers present ONE way (decided 2026-08-27): license and sensitive rise as BOTTOM SHEETS; the stance keeps the pad's own floating card, which is deliberately the same pad as everywhere else. License reads your default (a settings entry — new ruling), immutable after signing. Every stance the write signs is shown and adjustable: the post's own attachment is a ONE-AXIS pad (For/Against only — your own post always reaches you fully). Sensitive is one switch with a fixed per-field policy: it veils the BODY and the DESCRIPTION; the title and topics stay readable so choosing to look is informed. Optional reason, shown on the veil (new product decision — API field to add). Key absent = restore first: nothing staged, the draft stays on device, tertiary colouring — a waiting state, never error.

COMPOSE · Words, drafts, and after

The words body is the same wizard minus the cover step. Leaving mid-write keeps ONE local draft per target, on this device only — no discard confirm, the draft IS the safety. Signing exits to the post's own detail view: the post at top wearing 'Still settling' (its place in the feed comes as it settles), snackbar 'Signed — it's in the thread now, still settling.' If the act expires unlanded (Q38): a calm notice card in the shell — content left every reader's view, nothing was spent, the draft is saved. Never error colouring.

COMPOSE · Replying

The comment box in the thread is an ENTRY, not a composer: tapping it opens the same full-focus flow, pre-targeted, parent pinned. Two steps — words, then the seal. A comment is TEXT PLUS OPTIONAL MEDIA (comment.md: body text and media digests; text required) — deliberately asymmetric to the post's words-XOR-media body, because an answer is words first; '+ Add pictures' rides the writing step. The reply's stance on its parent (+0.10 / +0.10 default) is DISCLOSED on the seal and adjustable on the full two-axis pad: 'Replying also signs where you stand on the post it answers.' Topics and citations can join a comment from its seal, each row raising the count.

COMPOSE · Edit & remove

An edit is one screen and one batch (ruled 2026-08-27): the content edit PLUS topic and citation changes ride together — each add or withdrawal is its own priced act, the cost line reads the live total, and tapping it opens the breakdown sheet ('Edit · 1, Topic added · 1, Topic withdrawn · 1'), landing whole or not at all like every batch. License shown read-only with a lock. Earlier versions stay public under 'Edited'. Remove is the erasure path: own-post menu (a bottom sheet) → a think-twice dialog whose SAFE action is filled → the visible mark. 'Removed by its author' must never read like a moderation verdict — the two marks stay distinct. The thread and every response remain.

THE ? CONTENTS — each ? opens a plain dialog (see 'The ? dialog' board): title, at most two short paragraphs, Close. The copy, verbatim:

SEAL (post + reply) · 'Signed actions': Each piece of a post — the post itself, every topic, every citation — is its own signed action, written in your name. They sign together: all of them land, or none does. / You don't pay for these — a shared community pool covers members' signings. The pool is real and finite, so each action still counts.

LICENSE SHEET · 'The license': Terms for anyone who reuses what you publish — credit, and a public record of use. They are not a statement about how you made it. / The license is set when the post is first signed and can never change, not even by an edit. Your default lives in settings — Public domain until you change it.

SENSITIVE SHEET · 'Marking as sensitive': The mark veils the pictures and the description until a reader chooses to look. The title stays readable, so choosing is informed. / Your reason, if you give one, is shown on the veil. The mark is public and travels with the post.

KEY ABSENT · 'Your key': Signing needs your key, and it isn't on this browser. Nothing is signed or sent without it — the draft stays on this device. / Restore the key with your recovery code to finish. Restoring here is the only way to complete this write.

POST PAD · 'Where you stand on it': Publishing also signs where you stand on your own post — for or against, from a gentle +0.10 by default. / Your own post always reaches you in full, so only for-or-against is yours to set. Nothing is signed until Set. Prefer sliders or exact numbers? Swap the input in settings.

REPLY PAD · 'Toward what you answer': Replying also signs where you stand on the post you answer — for or against, and how much of it reaches you. It starts at a gentle +0.10 / +0.10 and rides the same signature as your reply. / Nothing is signed until Set. Swap the input in settings if you prefer sliders or numbers.

EDIT · 'Editing': An edit replaces the whole post; earlier versions stay public under 'Edited' unless you remove them. An edit never bumps the post as new. / Topic and citation changes ride the same signing, each as its own signed action. The license never changes.

CITE · 'Citing': A citation is its own signed action and carries where you stand on what you cite. You can cite anything on CoGra — start with @handle or #topic to reach comments, messages, and offers. / Comments and chat messages can also be cited from themselves — open one and choose 'Cite in a new post'.

SEARCH · 'Searching' (the Explore tab and the citing picker): Search reads names and titles, never bodies. Start with @handle to search one person's work — including their comments and offers, found through what they point at. Start with #topic to search inside a topic. / Results put what's closest to you first — the numbers are your view, no one else's. Below the line, what's still beyond your reach, newest first. Your searches stay on this device.

FILTER SHEET · 'The filter' (the feed's and search's sheets): What you let in, and in what order — the kinds combine freely, ranked or newest is one choice, and what you've already seen stays out unless you ask for it back. Every change applies as you tap; nothing here is signed or shared. / It lasts until you change it, on this device only. Your default lives in settings.

Citing — reached from Details. Searches everything citable: posts by title, people by name/handle, items by name, proposals by title, chats by name, campaigns by anchor, offers via their item. Comments and chat messages are cited from themselves — every content's overflow menu carries 'Cite in a new post'. These result rows are the seed of item 9's search.

COMPOSE · The post ladder — every container state in one place

From the smallest form (one line of words, nothing else) through bare media to the maximal collapsed container, plus the marked states: sensitive-veiled (blur + neutral wash + the author's reason; title and interaction row stay readable), removed by its author, and removed under the platform's rules — the two removal marks deliberately read differently.

THE HEIGHT RULE (2026-08-27): a post card's collapsed form never exceeds the screen height minus the bottom bar and the top safe zone — designed against the app / downloadable-webapp viewport, not browser chrome. Collapse order: the media and the interaction row NEVER shrink; tags and references collapse to one line under the description; the title clamps to one line; the description to two. The expanded detail view may be taller than the screen.

SEARCH — the Explore tab (item 9, rulings in readme §13 / Q46). At rest: the field, the orbit hero (item 16’s future 3D view), device-local recents. Searching: the worded filter trigger + the one “?”, ranked rows wearing the graph glyph, the seam, the aged tail. Scope operators @handle / #topic; indirect hits say their target on the second line.

FEED · The filter (item 19, growing item 4). The trigger sits on the CograBand's right edge — the band never spends its full width on identity alone — and scrolls away and back with it. EVERY feed view wears it, guests and applicants too: filtering is a read control. The trigger speaks deviations only ('Posts' at rest; 'Posts · photos · newest' when flipped; past the pill's budget the extras collapse to a count — '3 kinds · 4 changes', the far-from-default board). The sheet: ten kinds that combine — ONE list shared with search, 'Profiles' everywhere — forms of post, the Order section (Ranked/Newest + 'Show what you've already seen', DEFAULT OFF: what you've seen stays out until asked back; impression-based, device-local, shared transiently with the viewer's ranker; identical section on search), what else is admitted, Reset, and the sheet's own '?' (The filter dialog — names the settings default). Applies live. Everything off is allowed: the feed's empty state answers, not the chip.

MONEY · The CGT figure (item 11, system). One shape for every amount: two decimals, thousands grouped, the mark trailing where the unit word would sit. Dust is '< 0.01' — never 0.00, a shown number that lies — exact value one layer down; zero is '0', plainly (a new member's true state). Amounts are never negative: a minus is an OUTFLOW on a history line; positive inflows opt into '+'. No colour on direction — the system has no green, and error-colouring spending would call it a failure. The unit is the MARK everywhere (jakob 2026-08-31: the word 'CGT' repeated everywhere doesn't look nice); the word appears once — the wallet's balance headline, mark and word adjacent, its '?' explaining both as CoGra's own money. The mark is the BRAND MARK on the coin (jakob 2026-08-31, round 2): cogra-mark.svg verbatim, knocked out monochrome in the on-primary on the primary disc. Round 1's lone C read as any game's coin; CG letters, a CG interlock, and c+dot were drawn and rejected against it. The wallet's surfaces are item 12; pending amounts wait for it.

THE MEDIA SLICE (jakob 2026-08-31, for the product's media rebuild). The GALLERY IS A PAGER: every picture shares the post's one crop shape, swiped whole, dots only — never a '1/n' pill. Caps: 10 pictures or 1 video (+ its cover) per post; 4 pictures per comment. UPLOAD STARTS AFTER THE CROP — the crop happens on the device, only the cropped export is ever uploaded (the original can hold what the author never meant to share); comment pictures never crop, so they upload at pick. Progress rides the thumbnails as rings; a failed picture is marked on its tile with Retry · Remove beside it; the SEAL gates — signing waits for the pictures. DESCRIPTIONS (alt text) are authored, optional, never invented: entered per picture from the details step ('Describe the pictures · n of m described') and from the picked tray's Show all sheet — the per-picture manager (reorder, first = cover, remove, describe). Comment media is words-first: inset at the card's medium rung, capped at comment scale, same pager. Comment edit mirrors the post's one-screen-one-batch, license locked. Profile: ONE image — the avatar (no cover, per the ProfileHeader ruling); changing it is a SIGNED ACT with its own seal. Sensitive veils the WHOLE gallery, never one picture. Round 2 (jakob, same day): the details row carries NO Crop/Edit links ('none') — the row itself opens Show all; crop is one Back away — and the slice ships componentized (components/compose/: MediaThumb, PickedRow, DescribeCounter, PickedSheet, DescribeSheet, UploadStatusLine, UploadErrorLine, ActsCard), every board here rendered from the design system. Round 3 (implementation session's findings, same day): WEB has no device-gallery API, so 'Pick · the web variant' replaces the grid with the file picker + drop target — the rest of the step identical. The seal drift is healed in the component: ActsCard's note subline ('they land together, or none does') rides every MULTI-act seal's total; a single-act seal omits it. On the key-absent seal the ONE '?' belongs to the key notice (the 'Your key' dialog), not the header — one ? per screen, the key story outranks the seal story there. Off-role type values conformed to the pinned M3 roles (badge to label-small, writing bodies to 16/24, draft buttons to true padding) — M3 stays the default; no sub-roles added.
